text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Tanino Gimlet got injured during training, 
so I brought her to the infirmary.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
As expected of a healer. She made the pain 
of the injury vanish in the blink of an 
eye.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
"Then I have only one choice— to follow my 
fighting spirit."

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
"The gears of destiny are turning! There's 
no time to stop in our tracks here!"

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Sound the salpinx! Charge forward with a 
gallant command!
choice_data_list:
Let's make sure you get proper rest for 
now.

If it's just light training, I'll allow 
it.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
You dare ask me to play the rebel? ...Very 
well. You've piqued my interest in seeing 
how that future unfolds.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
At times, long trials serve as the 
springboard to reach the vast sky. Let us 
patiently await the time of fruition.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, Tanino Gimlet quietly rested and 
recuperated.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Yes! Those were the exact words I was 
waiting for! We have no time to waste! It 
is time to depart!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
"Oh, Destiny! Are you truly condemning me 
to the misery of banishment!?"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It looks like Tanino Gimlet's injury has 
worsened... I decided to halt training and 
let her rest.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Phew... Heheh... Hahahahaha! I have 
overturned the immutable!!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
"I am a seeker of fleeting brilliance!! 
Let all of time be transformed into 
gold!!!!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Tanino Gimlet trained within reasonable 
limits and made a smooth return to form!
